Portuguese Conversation Group


Sep 22, 2026 to Dec 23, 2026 — 1:30 p.m. to 2:30 p.m.
Every Tuesday

This group is an opportunity to practice Portuguese in a relaxed and interactive environment while discussing different topics related to Brazil and the Portuguese-speaking world. The group is open to students interested in developing their speaking skills and learning more about Portuguese-speaking cultures.

Participation form

Conversation group

Your answers in the form will help us better understand your level, interests, and learning goals and organize the conversation group accordingly. You will practice Portuguese and explore Brazilian and Lusophone cultures in a relaxed setting. Led by student facilitators under the guidance of Barbara Muniz Vieira and Danilo Marques.

Accessibility
If you require accommodation, please contact the event host as soon as possible.
